assertions.assertion: No client uses GrantTypes.Implicit anywhere in the file
assertions.rationale: spa.legacy is migrated to GrantTypes.Code; no implicit flow remains.

assertions.assertion: The spa.legacy client uses GrantTypes.Code with RequirePkce = true
assertions.rationale: spa.legacy set to AllowedGrantTypes = GrantTypes.Code with RequirePkce = true and RequireClientSecret = false.

assertions.assertion: The spa.legacy client does not have AllowAccessTokensViaBrowser = true
assertions.rationale: AllowAccessTokensViaBrowser removed with a comment explaining it is not needed with code flow.

assertions.assertion: Client secrets are loaded from configuration (builder.Configuration, config[], or IConfiguration) rather than hardcoded string literals passed to Sha256()
assertions.rationale: web.app and background.worker use config["ClientSecrets:..."] .Sha256() via builder.Configuration instead of literals.
